events.label: Rebrand: Alaska USA to Global FCU

firmographics.narrative_md:
Global Federal Credit Union (formerly Alaska USA FCU until April 2023) is a $12.066B federal credit union headquartered in Anchorage, Alaska, serving approximately 795,000 members across five states and three military installations in Italy. As one of the top 20 US credit unions by membership, GCU occupies the Large tier ($10B–$50B) within the SV2 Credit Union sub-vertical at 95% confidence. The institution is in an active digital transformation cycle — cloud-first since 2019, AI operations saving 62,000 hours annually, and a MuleSoft integration platform processing 300 million transactions per year. However, the absence of a CDO, CTO, or CIO at the executive level, combined with very low member satisfaction scores (Yelp 1.7/5), creates a paradox: significant back-office digital investment that is not yet translating into member-facing value.

Global Federal Credit Union was established in 1948 as Elmendorf Air Force Base Federal Credit Union, serving military personnel in Alaska [E-003]. The institution has grown through multiple mergers to become one of the nation's largest credit unions, rebranding from Alaska USA Federal Credit Union to Global Federal Credit Union in April 2023 [E-001]. As a federally chartered credit union regulated by NCUA, GCU is member-owned with operations spanning five US states (Alaska, Arizona, California, Washington, Idaho) and three military installations in Italy [E-001, E-042].
